title: AAPL Q4 Earnings Analysis
content: Apple reported record Q4 revenue of $383B, driven by strong iPhone 16 sales and Services growth. Operating margin expanded to 30.7%, with EPS of $6.73 beating consensus by $0.12.

title: Fed Minutes Summary - December 2025
content: The FOMC held rates steady at 5.25-5.50% for the fourth consecutive meeting. Committee members signaled potential rate cuts in Q1 2026 contingent on continued disinflation progress.

title: ESG Compliance Report - Tech Sector Q4 2025
content: Environmental scoring methodology updated per SEC Climate Disclosure Rule. Tech sector average ESG score improved to 72/100. AAPL leads at 85, MSFT at 83, GOOGL at 78.
